facts.fact: ICT and Digital Economy Principal Secretary John Tanui said the launch of the National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2025-2030 has positioned Kenya as a pioneer in Africa's digital transformation.

KEN.note: Nothing on AI built or hosted in the country.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications and the Digital Economy launched drafting of the National Data Governance Policy at a one-day workshop, with EU and GIZ support, according to Kenya News Agency.

KEN.note: The Office of the Data Protection Commissioner is only named in passing; no statement of its appointment or law.

facts.fact: PS John Tanui said Kenya's data protection environment is anchored by the Data Protection Act (2019) and the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner.
